authorization_reference: User: Launch training. Consecutive in-scope scratch experiments under program.md.
selection_rule: Final fresh U-Net192 40k FID must be lower than S2 final U-Net160 40k on both paired selection seeds, separately per NFE.
confirmation_rule: For each eligible NFE, final U-Net192 40k FID must be lower than S2 final 40k on all four paired confirmation seeds; otherwise inconclusive.
training_time_rationale: All 40000 fresh updates at measured 3.148384356 s/update give 34.982048 optimizer hours. Match S2 exposure and its full curriculum: S2 final 10k reduced FID 17.3%/7.6%, while a shorter or longer width192 horizon lacks a matched completed control. Confirmed width160 gains justify testing 89.14M versus 61.93M parameters, with 21.6% more projected optimizer time than actual S2. The 40h watchdog rounds up the slowest mean/last-half/terminal full estimate (35.172131h), plus 8% timing/recovery margin, twice S2 non-update overhead (1.530971h) and 60s shutdown. This never extends the 40k horizon.
evaluation_time_rationale: At most 32 passes: 12 S2 references and 20 S3 candidates (10 each NFE). Use per-NFE slowest measured S2 full passes (66.415/174.229s); S3 slowest qualified 95-batch generation (19.496/77.904s); add 1.5 times S2 largest total-pass minus generation residual (30.784s) per candidate, plus 60s startup. Total 3401.385s, then 20% margin and round to 4500s (75min), inclusive of any bounded recovery.
microbatch_rationale: Retain 16 at effective batch 128. Width192 microbatch32 improves mean/terminal timing only 3.11%/3.15%, below the declared 5% selection requirement, while using 13.518GB versus 7.693GB. Full augmentation, accumulation, optimizer and EMA were live in both probes. No further sweep; both costs retained; discard qualification states.
initialization_evidence: Qualification saved no generative checkpoint. Fresh production directory, no starting checkpoint; model/optimizer/EMA/RNG/data initialized at zero with a 40000-step horizon.
interpretation_rule: Generation-seed confirmation from one scratch training seed is not training-seed replication. Marginal or conflicting changes remain inconclusive for further scaling; no added seeds until a desired outcome appears.
next_decision: A substantive confirmed gain promotes the relevant track and supports fresh replication or recipe refinement. A negative/inconclusive result redirects to C3 or a fresh equal-compute smaller-model recipe; no automatic width or horizon extension.
